Container.Name: overmynd
Container.Overview: Download and transcode orchestrator for Sonarr, Radarr and Lidarr. Acts as their qBittorrent and SABnzbd download client, downloads through TorBox (or hands off to qBittorrent / NZBGet), sends video through Tdarr, hands the finished file back for import, and cleans up. Includes built-in RSS auto-download and a public status page for your users. The public pages are open, the admin pages sit behind a password and second factor on the same address, and the machine port is for your arrs only and must never be exposed outside your LAN. Settings are kept in /mnt/user/appdata/undermynd/config.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Public status page for your users, and the admin interface under /admin behind a password and second factor. Publish through your reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Machine port (LAN only)
Config.Description: Download client API used by Sonarr, Radarr and Lidarr (qBittorrent and SABnzbd compatible). Never expose this outside your LAN.

Config.Name: Configuration
Config.Description: Persistent database, settings and administrator account.

Config.Name: Downloads share
Config.Description: The share that holds both your download side and your final Complete folder. Mount it as /data. Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr and Tdarr must see the same paths (see the README).

Config.Name: Work folder
Config.Description: Where Overmynd keeps staging, the Tdarr hand-off folders and the local client downloads. Create a Tdarr library on tdarr/in and tdarr/out inside it.

Config.Name: Complete folder
Config.Description: The folder the arrs import from; one subfolder per category is created.

Config.Name: Media share
Config.Description: Your media library share. Used for the storage readout on the status page (free space and Movies, Episodes, Anime, Music and Books sizes) and by the Re-encode tab, which replaces a Movies, Episodes or Anime file with its AV1 version once Tdarr has made it and it has been checked. Nothing else is written here.

Config.Name: Storage root
Config.Description: Folder inside the container that holds the library folders Movies, Episodes, Anime, Music and Books. Leave empty to hide the storage readout.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as (Unraid: 99 for nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as (Unraid: 100 for users).
